benchmark.title: Benchmark Lab
benchmark.description: Our public, reproducible benchmark standard for AI video tools.
benchmark.heading: Benchmark Lab
benchmark.subtitle: A public standard, so you can verify our numbers yourself.
benchmark.intro: Marketing pages all claim the same things. The only way to compare tools honestly is to give them identical work and publish what comes back. Below are the five standard briefs we run, the exact measurements we record, and — importantly — how far through the programme we actually are.
benchmark.testedNote: {count} core AI video tools have completed our 24-point benchmark brief. We publish transparent sub-scores across Output Quality, Speed, Value for Money, Ease of Use, and Export Freedom.
benchmark.startNoteStrong: We are at the start of this.
benchmark.startNote: No tool has completed a full brief yet, so no tool on this site carries a numeric score. We would rather show an empty scoreboard than a full one we invented — every listing says plainly whether it has been tested, price-checked, or simply catalogued.
benchmark.briefsSub: Every tool in a category receives byte-identical input. No tool gets a second chance the others did not get.
benchmark.scoringIntro: Each tested tool gets five sub-scores from 0 to 10. The overall figure is a weighted average, computed rather than hand-adjusted, so we cannot quietly nudge a favourite upward.
benchmark.metricQualityDesc: How good is the result you can actually publish
benchmark.metricEaseDesc: Time to a first good result without reading documentation
benchmark.metricValueDesc: Output quality per dollar at the entry paid tier
benchmark.metricSpeedDesc: Wall-clock time from input to usable output
benchmark.metricExportDesc: Watermarks, resolution caps and commercial rights
benchmark.scoringNote: We use the full range. A 5 out of 10 is a normal, useful score — if nothing ever scored below 7, the numbers would carry no information at all.
independenceItems: We pay for our own subscriptions at the tier we test.
Vendors cannot pay for a score, a ranking position, or a re-test with a better result.
If we ever accept paid placement it will be labelled “Sponsored” and excluded from scoring entirely.
Where a tool has not been tested we say so, rather than filling the gap with a plausible-looking number.

b1.name: The podcast cut
b1.input: One fixed 60-minute two-person podcast episode, 1080p, lavalier audio.
b1.task: Produce the best five vertical short clips the tool can find, with captions burned in.
measures: Wall-clock time from upload to downloadable output
Caption word error rate against a human transcript
Speaker framing accuracy across cuts
How many of the five clips are genuinely publishable without edits
Cost in credits, converted to cost per finished clip

b2.name: The cinematic shot
b2.input: One fixed prompt: a specific camera move, subject and lighting condition.
b2.task: Generate the shot. Five attempts allowed, best result counts.
measures: Prompt adherence, scored against a written rubric
Temporal coherence — when artefacts first appear
Maximum usable clip length before the model drifts
Whether audio is generated natively
Attempts needed before one usable result, and total cost of those attempts

b3.name: The talking head
b3.task: Generate a full-screen avatar speaking the script.
measures: Lip-sync accuracy at normal playback speed
Natural eye movement and blink cadence
Render time from prompt submission to finished MP4
Cost per minute of finished video at the starter tier

b4.name: The clean-up
b4.input: One 60-second voice recording with air-conditioning hum and room echo.
b4.task: Clean the audio and level the voice.
measures: Noise reduction without audible gating artefacts
Preservation of natural voice timbre
Processing time

b5.name: The dub
b5.task: Dub into Spanish with voice cloning.
measures: Voice likeness to the original English speaker
Natural Spanish prosody and pacing
Whether commercial rights are included at the tier tested
Cost per finished audio minute

privacy.metaDescription: CreatorAI Hub privacy policy: what data we collect, how we use it, GDPR rights, and cookie usage.
privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1body: {site} (“we”, “us”) operates {host}, a curated directory of AI tools for video creators. This policy explains what personal data we collect, why, and your rights over it.
privacy.accountBody: if you sign in, we store your email address and authentication identifiers via our auth provider (Supabase).
privacy.newsletterBody: your email address and signup source, only when you subscribe.
privacy.reviewsBody: the display name, rating, and text you voluntarily submit.
privacy.bookmarksBody: saved-tool lists, stored locally on your device and — only for signed-in users — synced to your account.
privacy.analyticsBody: when you click an outbound tool link we log the tool name, timestamp, and referring page. We do not log your identity with clicks.
privacy.submissionsBody: the tool details and contact email you provide.
privacy.s3body: We do not sell your personal data. We do not run third-party advertising trackers. We do not share your email with tool vendors.
privacy.s4body: Essential cookies/localStorage keep you signed in and remember preferences (bookmarks, cookie consent, compare selections). Optional analytics cookies are only set if you click “Accept All” on the consent banner. You can clear them any time in your browser settings.
privacy.s5body: Some outbound links are affiliate links. Vendors may set their own cookies on their own domains after you leave our site; their privacy policies apply there. See our
privacy.s6body: Data is processed by Vercel (hosting) and Supabase (database & authentication). Both are GDPR-compliant processors with EU standard contractual clauses.
privacy.s7body: You may request access, correction, export, or deletion of your personal data at any time by emailing
privacy.s8body: This service is not directed to children under 16 and we do not knowingly collect their data.
privacy.s9body: We will update this page when the policy changes and revise the “last updated” date above.
privacy.s7end: . We respond within 30 days. Newsletter emails include a one-click unsubscribe link.

checklist: Text remains readable at small size

The visual matches the actual video promise
tips: Contrast an expected scene with one unexpected, truthful reveal.
Make the expert, evidence, or result the unmistakable focal point.
Show one unresolved visual clue and leave room for the viewer to ask “how?”
Use a single time-sensitive cue without inventing consequences.
Visually separate a credible before state from its after state.
